payload.summary: The full draft policy residents were asked to comment on, around 77 pages. It covers how the council handles applications, objections from residents and responsible authorities, conditions, reviews and enforcement, and it adds new sections on determining applications, on service standards and on shops selling alcohol to take away, plus three flow charts for applicants. It is the same file that went to the March committee as Appendix A. One thing to note: paragraphs 7.1 and 7.4 still read 'necessary and proportionate', the wording councillors asked on 5 March to be changed to 'appropriate and proportionate'.
